sentences.en: Both of us are very fond of curry and steak.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都非常喜欢咖喱和牛排。

sentences.en: It'd be nice if we had curry for dinner tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚吃咖喱倒是个不错的选择。

sentences.en: That was the first time that I ever made curry.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次自己做咖喱。

senses.zh: 咖哩粉，咖喱；咖哩饭菜；梳刷；鞭打
